Regional Land Use and Transportation Plan
The Southeastern Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission (SEWRPC) has completed and adopted a regional land use plan and a regional transportation (highway and mass transit) plan for the seven-county Southeastern Wisconsin Region. Since completion in 1966, these regional plan elements are being maintained current as part of an on-going comprehensive planning program conducted by SEWRPC.
In addition they have prepared a Jurisdictional Highway

System Plan and a Milwaukee Area Transit Plan, including specific recommendations for the improvement of highway and transit facilities.
They are currently preparing a regional airport system plan to identify the system of airports required to serve the existing and future regional air transportation demands. They have also underway a two-year study in cooperation with the Department of Transportation, Division of Highways and Department of Natural Resources, to produce a regional air quality maintenance plan.
SEWRPC's comprehensive regional land use transportation plan has identified the major regional facilities required to be developed by 1990 to serve the needs of the region.
